craft_notes: Sthāyin: withdrawal. Sanskrit-first: twofold kept. Rows: 2. Close: through. Rejected: flattening — killed: dvitayī counts. Read aloud: unhanding cadence.

lines: Unhand each gift; saints walk light.
l4.sanskrit_cite: saṃhṛtyaikaikamiṣṭiryā sāntyeṣṭirdvitayī matā | pūjādhyānajapāpluṣṭasamaye natu sādhake
